title: fix: pin gateway with Perplexity stream framing repair
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Pins production Portkey deployments to the merged [Perplexity stream-framing fix](https://github.com/pollinations/gateway/pull/11), commit `9ed9584bb8fcf61172dac8028b48c15957765f5d`.
- Prevents later default deployments from restoring the old parser. No deployment commands, routes, credentials, or secret mappings change.
- Verified shell syntax with `bash -n` and checked the diff. The gateway fix passed 52 focused tests and seven live local requests; its production deployment uses the existing dedicated workflow.

gist.headline: Streams stay in formation
gist.blurb: The gateway now stays pinned to the Perplexity stream-framing repair instead of wandering back to an older parser. The bees have arranged the tokens into a proper little line.
gist.summary: Pinned production Portkey gateway deployments to commit 9ed9584, which includes the merged Perplexity stream-framing repair and keeps later deployments from restoring the old parser.
gist.impact: Perplexity streaming responses keep their repaired event framing across production deployments, so apps can consume streamed output reliably.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy gateway garden where orderly glowing text-token streams flow through a tiny Portkey-style archway into a retro terminal, representing stable Perplexity stream framing. Polli wears a small mechanic cap and gently pins a neat ribbon of tokens in place while code-plants and flowers grow around the gateway; the monitor robot can watch the stream arrive in clean, separated lines.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, a cute pixel bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny mechanic cap as she pins a neatly framed stream of glowing text tokens through a little gateway arch into a retro CRT terminal; a cheerful monitor robot watches clean lines of data beside flowering code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with small pixel-font text: "STREAM OK".
